## Set up 
1. Set up your session:

```{r 1. Project Setup, message = FALSE}
# Loading packages and checking working directory
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
here()
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
```
## Read in Data

```{r 1. Project Data, message = FALSE}

# California boundary
cal_boundary <- read_sf(here("./Data/Raw/california.gpkg"))
dim(cal_boundary)


# Event Data
event_data <- read_sf(here("./Data/Raw/Raw_large/fired_uscan_to2021121_events_gpkg_shp/fired_uscan_to2021121_events.gpkg"))
dim(event_data)

```
